text.brief: During a crisis in the Strait in 2032, a video of the commander of Indo-Pacific Command ordering strikes on mainland ports spreads to 40 million phones in two hours. The admiral is on a flight to Guam.
text.record: The FBI warned in May 2025 that criminals and hostile actors were using AI voice messages to impersonate senior American officials ([FBI IC3](https://www.ic3.gov/PSA/2025/PSA250515)). The Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity publishes an open standard for content credentials. Few government agencies attach those credentials to their own video.
text.reading: The Party fills the first hours of a crisis with synthetic orders and confessions. Allies hesitate, markets panic and the real chain of command spends its time denying. This is Stratagem 7, create something from nothing.
text.coreEvent: A synthetic video of a senior American or Taiwanese official spreads widely during a crisis before 2036.
text.gapText: Data Architecture. Governments publish official video with no proof of origin, so a fake order and a real one look the same.
text.fix: Sign every official video and establish verified channels before the crisis.
